source: University of Colorado Colorado Springs (UCCS) Planning, Design & Construction - public bid set, Cybersecurity and Space Ecosystem Expansion project, issued 2021-05-04.
note: The full bid set is 133 pages / ~43MB - too large to commit here. These 5 files are individual sheets extracted from it, picked to cover multiple disciplines and both 'real prose' and 'legend/symbol table' page types, since those stress the extractor very differently. Re-download the full set from source_url if you need more pages (e.g. for the electrical discipline - every E-series sheet in this set embeds several large scanned raster images per page, 30MB+ each once isolated, so none were included here).
